limits: Tiny fixed-order pilot; no statistical significance or production quality claim.
One ComfyUI process per endpoint: two queued requests do not prove two simultaneous GPU inferences.
Provider execution time includes handler work; Comfy execution includes model loading, text/reference encoding, denoising, decoding and PNG output.
Queue/startup time includes provider waits and may contain unbilled container/model-cache preparation; it is not a billing duration.
Attempt 3 cache-none disables loader output reuse. Attempts 4-6 reuse loaders with fresh encoders. Neither is a multi-copy optimized pod.
Completed-round images/minute includes request/delivery and the in-round two-second gap when applicable, but excludes the preceding 30-second pause and initial startup. It is not GPU-only throughput.
The GPUs ran in different observed regions and different attempts. Hardware, placement, startup and network effects are not independently isolated; no causal location penalty is measured.
FlashBoot idle/ready snapshots are distinct from forced cold starts. Idle count alone does not establish billing; the H100 UI showed a zero spend rate while health retained idle=1.
Total account debit is measured separately; no per-GPU invoice split is inferred.
No cost or time for narration, Luna, vision checks, repair, rendering or final video is included in image-stage projections.
Decode/black-frame checks are not story or character-quality checks.

costs.settlementStatus: Observed account debit includes standing storage during testing; later postings may change total. Do not add storage to the debit again.
